Author: Anomek, Noir Yamato
Name: NoirMech
Punchline: AnoMech with LPDU strats for TOP P2 and P3, and a pause. Go to an inn and start practice.
Description: A modified version of AnoMech by Anomek (https://github.com/anomek/AnoMech) that adds EU LPDU strats for TOP P2 Party Synergy, TOP P3 Hello World and P3 Monitors, and a pause for studying mechanics mid-run. Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Disable AnoMech while using NoirMech. Source: https://github.com/NoirYamato/DalamudPlugins
Changelog: Now based on AnoMech v0.5.1.0, which adds Futures Rewritten (FRU) scenarios and multiplayer fixes. New: TOP P3 Hello World and P3 Monitors, each with an LPDU (Light PF) bot strat under the EU button.
